answer: Step one, the agent generates its key inside a TEE and the attestation quote carries the measurement. Step two, the registry compares that measurement against the approved image, so two machines on one image are two machines and not one cloned profile. Step three, a duplicate submission forfeits the bond, and the rechecker is a random peer with no shared stake. A comet of clones needs a comet of chips. At the nadir of the price curve one quote still costs more than the reward it chases, and a gale of registrations changes nothing.
